policy: Scope museum-vrindavan only. Preserve the SPN museum and global shared section vocabulary and assignments. A museum-specific catalogue or projection must not rename shared sections globally.
Exactly six visitor-facing section roots in the stated order; keep Needs section proposal as an operational review state, not a seventh physical region.

Preserve old section, family/subgroup keys, tier, alternatives, confidence, rationale, sources and original comparisons. Six-region consolidation is not a reason to change tiers or manufacture relationships.

Use explicit reviewed book assignments for securely matched identities, then coherent family/subgroup context and reviewed spiritual geography. Mixed legacy buckets require row-level review; this crosswalk is not a bulk saint import.
Brahma Kumaris remain one chapter-five subsection anchored at Mount Abu. Keep major overseas work in biographies/locality data. No artificial Mount Abu residence is inferred for every teacher.

Limit working saint proposals to the current confirmed Vrindavan inventory/canonical identities; retain unresolved source rows in their existing identity workflow. The book catalogue and 1399-row old export do not establish Vrindavan presence.

Preserve human curator overrides. Where a reviewed override conflicts with the new structure, surface the old and new proposal for review instead of silently overwriting it. Map alternatives to the same six-region vocabulary while retaining original values.

Update independent Vrindavan planning/proposals only. No physical shelf/vitrine or move-completed status, shared saint locality, relationship, publication state, relic provenance, Airtable source record or other museum assignment changes are authorized by this section update.

Book omissions are edition-specific. Do not remove Baba Udasin, anonymous labels or the duplicate inventory objects from the museum catalogue. The book duplicate can be reconciled only through already-confirmed canonical identity links; no automatic CMS merge.

Use real current-inventory counts per canonical saint, counting a person once. Do not import the book’s 275/272 figures as Vrindavan counts; collection objects and combined-person entries require their own preserved accounting.
Maheshwar Yogi and other truly unresolved regional assignments remain retained and unassigned. Do not invent an Indian location or merge identities to fill all six sections.

Implementation must cover reads, save/family-move validation, alternatives, filters, counts, section routes and revision/arrangement invalidation consistently. Preserve museum access controls and the existing audit/conflict workflow.
No deployment requested. Report exactly what is implemented locally, what is staged as proposals, and whether any canonical/production data was changed.
Version 2 supersedes book-first precedence: preserve reviewed lineages before geography.
